content:
**MCQ: Which of the following is a cause of hypoparathyroidism?**

A. Parathyroid gland removal/damage during thyroid surgery  
B. Pituitary adenoma  
C. Hyperthyroidism (Graves disease)  
D. Pheochromocytoma  

**Correct answer: A. Parathyroid gland removal/damage during thyroid surgery**
